defs.def: to fire a gun or other weapon; to fire sth from a weapon 开（枪或其他武器）；射击；发射

ex.s: They reached the shooting spot later than expected.

defs.def: to kill or wound a person or an animal with a bullet, etc. 射杀；射伤
to fire bullets, etc. 枪或其他武器
to hunt and kill birds and animals with a gun as a sport 打猎；狩猎；打（猎物）；猎杀

ex.s: Hunters were shooting antelopes to make profits.
ex.t: 猎人们为了牟利而猎杀羚羊。

ex.s: Summers in the mid-70s were spent at home shooting baskets, hitting a baseball, or throwing a football, preparing for my future as a quarterback on a football team.
ex.t: 70年代中期的夏天，我都在家里投篮、打棒球或扔橄榄球，为我将来当橄榄球队四分卫做准备。

defs.def: to move suddenly or quickly in one direction; to make sb/sth move in this way （使朝某方向）冲，奔，扑，射，飞驰

ex.s: We could see that the beams were now vertical and were shooting straight towards the sky.
ex.t: 我们可以看到，光束现在是垂直的，直射向天空。

defs.def: to move suddenly and quickly and be very sharp 剧痛跳窜
to direct sth at sb suddenly or quickly 突然把 … 投向
to make a film/movie or photograph of sth 拍摄；摄影

ex.s: To make some of my landscape shots, I have traveled up to four hours away to shoot within a 10-minute time frame.
ex.t: 为了拍摄我的一些风景照，我曾驱车长达四小时，只为在十分钟的时间窗口内拍摄。

ex.s: By shooting in the countryside or state parks.
ex.t: 通过在乡村或州立公园拍摄。

ex.s: Still, looking back on the photos, they are some of my best shots though they could have been so much better if I would have been prepared and managed my time wisely.
ex.t: 尽管如此，回头看这些照片，它们仍是我最好的作品之一，不过如果我准备充分、合理安排时间，它们本可以好得多。

defs.def: to try to kick, hit or throw the ball into a goal or to score a point 足球、曲棍球等

ex.s: We all spoke the same language of passes and shots.
ex.t: 我不擅长足球，但那个晚上很美好。

to play particular games 玩，打（某种游戏）
to talk with too much pride about sth 吹嘘；大吹大擂
